whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Battalion House The Multi cuisine,

I noticed your multi-cuisine restaurant has stellar 4.9★ reviews on Boring Road, but lacked a dedicated mobile booking and digital menu page.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table reservation, multi-cuisine menu showcase, aur instant Google directions integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/battalionhouse

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team Battalion House The Multi cuisine, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp table booking, a multi-cuisine menu showcase, and Google directions for your Boring Road location. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact menu items, professional photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
